room_description: A vibrant green living room with a large white L-shaped sofa, a zebra-print rug, and a modern TV stand.

key_moments.description: Establishing shot of the green living room.
Finding a sharp knife hidden under the coffee table.
Cutting the sofa cushion with the knife to find a red remote.
Finding a crowbar inside the white cabinet.
Using the crowbar to pry open the door of the modern fireplace.
Tapping the toilet tank (oddly placed in wall) to find a clue.
Using the remote to turn on the TV and see the color bars.
Counting the colored fish on the wall: 7 Purple, 4 Green, 6 Red.
Entering '746' into the numeric safe drawer.

solution_steps: Find the knife under the triangular coffee table.
Use the knife to slice the seat of the white sofa.
Pick up the red TV remote.
Use the remote to turn on the TV, which shows color bars: Purple, Green, Red.
Count the corresponding colored fish decorations on the green wall.

final_action: The player takes the blue keycard from the drawer and uses it to unlock the exit door at the back of the room.
